Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified OTRAG’s country as the Democratic Republic of the Congo by conflating its rocket test site (Zaire/DRC) with the company’s actual headquarters. Credible sources indicate OTRAG was a West German (German) company based in Stuttgart/Neu-Isenburg. This misinterpretation would lead to the wrong conclusion that Kaufland and OTRAG are not in the same country, whereas the correct answer is yes.
